packet_ABI: MC v2, 0x02500002; actual4x128bit request and return frames

program.native_service_ID: 0x0250; actual PM table/header words are read and checked before use
program.current_scope_of_interpreter: The explicitly registered single-scope three-instruction kernel, not the full old LC ISA or an arbitrary old PM image
program.boot: BEGIN/sequential WRITE128/SEAL performs352 actual byte CRC readbacks for this kernel; every config write has a real receipt. Rejected config does not revoke deployment. Accepted revocation requires new drained session before calls resume.
program.PREPARE: prepared is derived from actual PM certification AND accepted strictly newer native session; it is not a host constant
program.reserved_loop_diagnostic: CALL r7 low16 is an ignored bounded diagnostic, high16 must be zero; it is not an implicit LC iteration command

storage.terminal_packet: composed from retained owner/counters while held, no separate64B response array
storage.physical_cost: owner/token/sequence/counters/FSM/comparators/config and clocks/reset are additional real logic, not covered by this payload inventory; P&R pending

scope.input_key_and_RFowner: independent typed identities; never replace with the CALL scope owner
scope.transport: two real64B DDR requests, each competes with W for actual global descriptor/beat/channel credits; one live scope remains leased through terminal service drain and explicit fetch release
scope.integrity: 124 sequential CRC cycles against inline tailCRC, then root typed decoder reads these same scope registers without copying
scope.confirmed_read_bytes: only matching accepted DDR returns, plus actual native provider counters; CRC failure/cancel never invents a full128B read
scope.provider: P schema02505001/provider02504d02: service1 RANGE, <=16contexts; services2 projection outer and3 wholeFFN rejected until separately implemented

native_completion: L_EXEC launches actual native service; L_WAIT waits matching full owner/ticket. Only actual provider completion, including FINAL/SPILL S128 ACKs, can satisfy it. INPUT-consumed does not satisfy L_WAIT or free the scope.
cancel: Full v2 owner and zero argument payload required. Preserve held PM requests, source DDR offers and held service offer. Stop new issue, partial CLOSE/no-more-issue plus all issued returns drain, then native service must report actual full drain. CANCEL acceptance alone never fabricates completion. Held terminal is immutable.
session: PM must already be certified; accepted session init is atomic with the fetcher init, strictly newer generation and real transport_drained. A pre-boot attempt cannot burn the fetch generation. No automatic reset/rearm drain proof.
admission_boundaries: one actual P LC control/typed range fixture
record provider is currently a finite peer in this LC test, not numerical M or actual S ACK coverage
global DMA fabric must still be connected to actual requests/returns/CLOSE
five native provider registrations and wholeFFN outer are separate
